name: Kit Builder
notes: v1.0.0 — knob-grid redesign: every page redrawn with real knob/enum-square/trigger widgets on schwung's own param-page grid. RANDOM, SYSTEM and EXPORT now open behind a door (jog wheel scrolls, click acts). KIT drops the redundant Pad-select knob for a pad press; Gain moves to Knob 1 with a peek-overlay value. Knob-ring LEDs show which knob does something per page. Kit Builder now stops a playing background track on open, since its notes were indistinguishable from real pad presses. See CHANGELOG.md for the full list.
